text: The sponsor GCS is Griffin Core Solutions: the club describes GCS as a company dedicated to engineering, services and regulation projects in the aerospace sector, founded in 2021 and based in the Vallecas neighbourhood of Madrid; Unión Rayo reported the new sponsor as Griffin Core Solutions; and the company's website legal notice names GRIFFIN CORE SOLUTIONS S.L. as the controller of the site.
short: GCS is Griffin Core Solutions S.L., a Madrid aerospace company founded in 2021.

source.name: Rayo Vallecano official site, 'GCS, nuevo patrocinado del Rayo Vallecano'
source.quote: GCS es una compañía dedicada a proyectos de ingeniería, servicios y regulación en el sector aeroespacial. Fundada en 2021 y establecida en el barrio de Vallecas

additionalSources.name: OneFootball (Unión Rayo): El Rayo Vallecano estrenó patrocinador (Griffin Core Solutions) ante el Alavés
additionalSources.quote: El Rayo Vallecano tiene nuevo patrocinador: Griffin Core Solutions
